T6 and T7 stand in no castle and keep input 19's first 900. A cubic metre of repair restores the shot's structure damage over its crater in the template's material, 100 over stone's 2 voxels, 50, and 100 over timber's 7, floored to 14 (ADR-028, decision 4).
